about_the_game:
Add the game to your wishlist

Economic Clicker is an exciting economic simulator-clicker that lets you rise from a budding entrepreneur to the owner of a vast business empire! Start with simple tasks like collecting bottles or performing on the streets to earn your first coins. Gradually develop your skills, unlock new ways to make money, and invest in upgrades to boost your income.

In the game, you’ll find:

  • Diverse Upgrades: From "Business Surge" to "Work as a Courier" — each upgrade opens new earning opportunities.

  • Research and Mechanics: Unlock new features like "Advertising Campaigns" to accelerate your business growth.

  • Shops and Investments: Buy kiosks, minimarkets, supermarkets, and even shopping malls to expand your influence.

  • Simple Controls: Tap on the banknote to earn money and use it to grow your empire.

  • Statistics and Settings: Track your progress, check your stats, and customize the game to your liking.

Dive into the world of business where every decision shapes your success! Can you become a tycoon and build your economic empire? The game is currently a "Work in Progress," so expect regular updates with new features and improvements.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Economic Clicker is an economic clicker where you start from scratch and build a business empire! Earn money, unlock upgrades, research new mechanics, and buy shops. Simple controls, addictive gameplay, and constant updates await you!
